meta.title: Dimension-Based Routing: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Verify that Dimension-Based Routing is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.
Use Dimension-Based Routing to route approvals by department, state, or category.
Repeat the same routing steps on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that they work.
Compare the same Tenant Admin's capability across Growth and Enterprise plan tiers.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that Dimension-Based Routing is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.; Use Dimension-Based Routing to route approvals by department, state, or category.; Repeat the same routing steps on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that they work.; Compare the same Tenant Admin's capability across Growth and Enterprise plan tiers.

args.need: sign in as the Tenant Admin on Growth and Enterprise tenants, verify Dimension-Based Routing is unavailable or refused on Growth, then use it to route approvals by department, state, or category on Enterprise and confirm it works

steps.note: The catalog cannot access plan-tier administration or the Dimension-Based Routing approval configuration.
After the tester completes the Enterprise portion, confirm the named capability is visible on the resulting screen; this does not cover the Growth refusal or the routing outcome.
